Repro night-maintenance-clock (the clock trick of bp-spreads-*: 22:00 at the window start, ~9.6 sim-minutes per real second, so 3 AM fires at ~31 s (warm-up, not counted) and ~183 s [inferred from the rate, moves with it/s]; the stuck-check alarms follow 20-60 sim-minutes = 2-6 real s later). Each fire is decided by the switch state when its alarm runs: read per fire, not per slice. Pass also: on side patches stuckcheckasync_run > 0, _dropped small, _maxwait_simsec a few sim-minutes; off side 0. Read: sync plan lines with RunStuckCheckHelper.RunOrig in the stack (count, max/sum ms, reason; the on side's stack ends in StuckCheckDrain), worst iteration within 10 s of the fire, worst-hitches.ts --min 300, Sims reset by the check (equal within seed drift). Off-first (warm-up on, then off,on,on,off); read with bp-stuckcheck-onfirst (mean of both per-side deltas cancels the slot-1 bias, docs/136 §2).
